mapper.sql: id, device_id, protocol, command_type, request_payload, status, sent_at, ack_at, response_payload, operator, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select from ipe_ops.command_record order by id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into ipe_ops.command_record (device_id, protocol, command_type, request_payload, status, sent_at, ack_at, response_payload, operator, created_at, updated_at) values (#{deviceId}, #{protocol}, #{commandType}, #{requestPayload}, #{status}, #{sentAt}, #{ackAt}, #{responsePayload}, #{operator}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update ipe_ops.command_record set device_id = #{deviceId}, protocol = #{protocol}, command_type = #{commandType}, request_payload = #{requestPayload}, status = #{status}, sent_at = #{sentAt}, ack_at = #{ackAt}, response_payload = #{responsePayload}, operator = #{operator}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
